messages:
Maya (Eng): Hey folks 0week plan: 10 weeks split across Lisbon and Porto starting July. Staying on US payroll. Quick Qs: am I eligible for the WFH stipend while abroad? Any import duties or shipping limits for moving my ergo desk? Also worried about tax/nexus risk if I be ~65% in Portugal.

Ravi (People Ops): Short answers: stipend applies prorated while temporary abroad (we typically pay $120/mo prorated). Shipping reimbursable with receipts but needs prepproval for >$750. Use the temp-remote form and attach shipping quote + manager signoff.

Maya (Eng): Who approves the prepproval and how long does legal review take?

Clara (Legal): We do a quick jurisdiction check on submission. For single short stints company PE/nexus risk is low; personal tax residency (183-day rule) is the main concern. Portugal has import VAT/duty on shipped goods; small shipments under customs thresholds often fine but check courier rules. Mark it "temporary remote EU" and well review within 48 hours.

Zoe (Payroll): If you stay on US payroll stipend remains USD. If Legal advises localization we may pause stipend until payroll transition completes. Make sure your tax docs (W9/W8) are current.

Ravi (People Ops): Link: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/temp-remote-form. Note: shipping preapproval up to $750 from People Ops; higher needs finance signoff.

Maya (Eng): Filing now and will attach a courier quote. Thanks all.
